title: Deciphering allosteric mechanisms in KRAS activation: insights from GTP-induced conformational dynamics and interaction network reorganization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2261-2274
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07924H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
De-Rui Zhao, Ji-Tong Yang, Meng-Ting Liu, Li-Quan Yang, Peng Sang
KRAS activation is driven by GTP binding, leading to increased flexibility and dynamic network reorganization. This study highlights the critical roles of switch I, switch II, and P-loop in mediating allosteric signaling pathways.
